errors.text_span: като използва хоризонталната ос за категориите и вертикалната ос за стойностите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the axes. This is a horizontal bar chart, so the categories are on the vertical axis and the values are represented on the horizontal axis. The description reverses this.

errors.text_span: в низходящ ред според броя на населението
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the population size categories are listed in descending order. They are listed in ascending order of population size (Up to 10k, 10-20k, 20-50k, etc.).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва процентни стойности от 0% до 100%, със стъпка от 10%, макар че не са означени числата.
errors.evidence: The description invents a value axis scale that does not exist. The figure has no visible axis line, tick marks, or numerical labels for the value axis. The range (0-100%) and step (10%) are fabricated.

errors.text_span: 31,1% от населението е в общини с население до 10 000 души
errors.evidence: The description misinterprets what the percentage values represent. It claims they show the percentage of the population, but the chart displays the percentage of administrative units that fall into each category, not the distribution of the total population.
